supporting_queries.rate_query: SELECT ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(hallucination_rejected_count),0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(total_elements),0)) * 100, 2) AS hallucination_rate_percent FROM diagrams;
supporting_queries.count_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS diagrams, COALESCE(SUM(total_elements),0) AS total_elements, COALESCE(SUM(hallucination_rejected_count),0) AS hallucination_rejected_total FROM diagrams;
supporting_queries.window_query: SELECT MIN(created_at) AS earliest_diagram, MAX(created_at) AS latest_diagram FROM diagrams;
